claim: Raising Cane's is overrated bland : r/unpopularopinion - Reddit
summary: Raising Cane's is overrated bland I don't get what the hype is about Cane's. The chicken is so bland and dry I think it rival's a Popeye's biscuit, I have to take gulps of a drink with it otherwise I will suffocate. The french fries are meh... and the lemonade is very watered down, can hardly taste the flavors.
